name: AuditWeave
capability_claim: Measures exact abductive reconstruction and counterfactual execution of a formally specified state machine under partial-order and lossy-audit evidence.
determinism: Generation is deterministic for sample-count and seed; each published item is exhaustively checked to have one derivable answer.

closest_benchmarks.name: MuSR
closest_benchmarks.difference: Both require multi-step evidence reconciliation, but AuditWeave uses executable formal semantics, partial orders, and exhaustive exact grading rather than natural-language narrative questions.

closest_benchmarks.name: BIG-Bench Hard algorithmic tasks
closest_benchmarks.difference: AuditWeave adds abductive candidate repair, checkpoint constraints, and counterfactual replay over a fresh generated trace rather than direct forward execution.

closest_benchmarks.name: SWE-bench
closest_benchmarks.difference: AuditWeave concerns forensic identification in a closed state machine and has no repository patching, underspecified tests, or judge-based correctness.
